preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 2 and 500 inclusive.
The number of edges m is between 1 and the minimum of n(n-1) and 100000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the valid range [1, n].
All directed edges in the input are unique.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' if (is_acyclic(edges) or any(is_acyclic([e for e in edges if e != removed]) for removed in edges)) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output YES if the graph is already acyclic or becomes acyclic by removing exactly one edge; otherwise output NO.
